description:
## What

For each of the 12 crates in narrow 1.0 scope, consolidate the current `[Unreleased]` content into a new `## 1.0.0 — <TBD>` section at the top. The literal asks from PKIX-wlsr.7:

- `## 1.0.0 - YYYY-MM-DD` heading (use TBD or a placeholder; Mark fills the real date at publish time)
- Summary line: 'First stable release.'
- `### Breaking` enumeration when applicable
- `### Added` enumeration since last 0.x
- `### Fixed` enumeration since last 0.x
- Link to relevant beads where useful (don't over-link)

## Affected crates

All 12 in the narrow 1.0 scope:
pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-chain, pkix-path-builder, pkix-truststore, pkix-identity, pkix-profiles, pkix-profiles-cabf, pkix-lint, pkix-lint-cabf, pkix-revocation-http, pkix-aia

## Blocks

- PKIX-wlsr.7.1 must close first (the 7 missing CHANGELOGs need to exist before they can be rolled up)

## Heading-style decision needed

The existing five CHANGELOGs use inconsistent breaking-change heading styles:
- `### Changed (breaking)` (pkix-chain)
- `### Removed (breaking)` (pkix-lint-cabf)
- No breaking heading at all despite a behavior change (pkix-profiles-cabf max_path_len removal)

The roll-up should pick one convention and apply it consistently across all 12 crates. Recommendation: `### Breaking` as the umbrella heading (matches the bead's own naming).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Each 1.0-scope crate's CHANGELOG.md has a `## 1.0.0 — <TBD>` heading at top
- [ ] Each entry has a 'First stable release.' summary line
- [ ] `### Breaking` / `### Added` / `### Fixed` sub-sections used consistently across all 12
- [ ] `[Unreleased]` section preserved as an empty heading for future work (post-1.0 next changes)
- [ ] Bead links accurate; no fabricated bead IDs

## Cross-references

- PKIX-wlsr.7 (parent)
- PKIX-wlsr.7.1 (blocks)
title: Roll up [Unreleased] -> ## 1.0.0 entry in all 12 1.0-scope crate CHANGELOGs
